items.text: 所有触摸操作应有即时视觉反馈。
items.evidence: PRESSED -> SET_OPACITY 190 and RELEASED -> 255 on every clickable object (scripts/gen_spec.py touch_feedback=190)
items.reason: The spec engine has no pressed-state style. Touch feedback (pressed opacity/scale) must be added in C with lv_obj_set_style_* on LV_STATE_PRESSED, or by wiring PRESSED/RELEASED + SET_OPACITY events in a later iteration.
